edges.reason: msg.sender feeds _msgSender() into approve/transfer paths and owner comparison inside _transfer.
block.timestamp is used for the cooldown requirement and cooldown write inside _transfer (timestamp dependency).
block.timestamp is passed as router deadline in openTrading.
block.timestamp is passed as deadline to the router swap call.
Public transfer() invokes _transfer.
Public transferFrom() invokes _transfer.
transferFrom() calls _approve to decrement allowance.
_transfer ends by calling _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer delegates to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam.
_transferStandard obtains tAmount-derived values from _getValues for fee arithmetic.
_getValues relies on _getRate whose division determines reflection amounts.
_rOwned balances are read and written in _transferStandard.
_transferStandard writes updated reflection balances into _rOwned.
_takeTeam credits the contract reflection balance in _rOwned.
_transfer reads balanceOf(_rOwned) of the contract to size the swap.
bots blacklist mapping is required to be false in _transfer.
cooldown mapping is compared against block.timestamp and updated in _transfer.
tradingOpen guards and is set by openTrading.
swapEnabled gates the auto swap-and-send block inside _transfer.
cooldownEnabled gates the cooldown/max checks inside _transfer.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from/to to classify buys and sells.
_maxTxAmount is used in the amount <= _maxTxAmount requirement.
_maxWalletAmount is used in the balanceOf(to) + amount <= _maxWalletAmount requirement.
openBlock is compared with block.number to apply launch penalties.
_swapTokensAtAmount is compared against the contract balance to set canSwap.
onlyOwner setMaxTxAmount writes _maxTxAmount (owner-only state change).
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth before finalizing state, enabling mid-transfer external router interaction.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee which performs native ETH transfers from the same transaction flow.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call.
swapTokensForEth reads uniswapV2Router for WETH and the swap target.
lockTheSwap modifier writes inSwap around the external swap call.
sendETHToFee performs ETH transfers to _feeAddrWallet1/_feeAddrWallet2.
sendETHToFee reads _feeAddrWallet1 as the transfer destination.
sendETHToFee reads _feeAddrWallet2 as the transfer destination.
Unrestricted manualSwap() invokes swapTokensForEth on the full contract balance.
Unrestricted manualSend() invokes sendETHToFee on the full contract ETH balance.
openTrading performs an external payable addLiquidityETH call to the router.
openTrading assigns uniswapV2Router and reads factory/WETH from it.
openTrading writes the created pair address into uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading calls _approve which writes _allowances for the router.
_approve writes the owner/spender allowance entry.
_msgSender() is passed as the owner argument when approving.
_msgSender() determines the spender checked in transferFrom allowance subtraction.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter from is only consumed as the sender key inside _transfer's bot, fee and balance logic.
Parameter to is only consumed inside _transfer for pair detection, cooldown and max wallet checks.
Parameter amount is only used inside _transfer for the max transaction and wallet limit requirements.
Local contractTokenBalance is computed solely to derive canSwap inside _transfer.
Local contractETHBalance represents the ETH passed into sendETHToFee from the swap flow.
Parameter tokenAmount is the sole amount forwarded in the swapTokensForEth external swap call.
